title: The Book by the Pond
lines: Ben took a good book to the pond.
Mom sat with him on the soft bank.
Ben stood on a log made of wood.
A duck came to look at his book.
Mom held Ben as the wet log shook.
His good book fell in the pond!
Ben got a long stick from the bank.
The stick was short and did not reach.
Then Ben took a hook from his bag.
He set the hook on the stick with string.
Ben stood with Mom and got the book back.
It was wet, so he took it home.

questions.ask: Where did Ben stand to read his book?
questions.listenFor: On a log made of wood, by the pond. Have them point to that line.

questions.ask: Why did the long stick not work at first?
questions.listenFor: It was short and did not reach. So Ben set a hook on it with string.

questions.ask: The story says the wet log shook. What does shook mean? Show me with your hands.
questions.listenFor: Moved and wobbled. Line five. Acting it out is the check that they really have the word.
